import sqlite3
import json
import urllib.request
import stripe
DATABASE_PATH = 'smart_home.db'
INVENTORY_WEBHOOK_URL = 'https://inventory.internal.example.com/api/part-orders'

def _notify_inventory_service(device_id, payment_intent_id, amount_cents, previous_room_id, new_room_id):
    payload = json.dumps({'device_id': device_id, 'payment_intent_id': payment_intent_id, 'amount_cents': amount_cents, 'previous_room_id': previous_room_id, 'new_room_id': new_room_id}).encode('utf-8')
    request = urllib.request.Request(INVENTORY_WEBHOOK_URL, data=payload, headers={'Content-Type': 'application/json'}, method='POST')
    urllib.request.urlopen(request, timeout=10).close()

def buy_replacement_part_and_reassign_room(device_id, target_room_id, payment_method_id, battery_pack_price_cents):
    database_connection = sqlite3.connect(DATABASE_PATH)
    try:
        existing_device_row = database_connection.execute('SELECT room_id, owner_customer_id FROM devices WHERE id = ?', (device_id,)).fetchone()
        if existing_device_row is None:
            return {'ok': False, 'error': 'device not found'}
        previous_room_identifier, owning_customer_identifier = existing_device_row
        payment_intent_for_battery_pack = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(amount=battery_pack_price_cents, currency='usd', customer=owning_customer_identifier, payment_method=payment_method_id, off_session=True, confirm=True, description=f'Battery pack for device {device_id}')
        database_connection.execute('UPDATE devices SET room_id = ? WHERE id = ?', (target_room_id, device_id))
        database_connection.commit()
        _notify_inventory_service(device_id, payment_intent_for_battery_pack.id, battery_pack_price_cents, previous_room_identifier, target_room_id)
    finally:
        database_connection.close()
    return {'ok': True, 'payment_intent_id': payment_intent_for_battery_pack.id, 'previous_room_id': previous_room_identifier, 'new_room_id': target_room_id}
